source: claude-api skill bundled with Claude Code 2.1.309: shared/models.md, shared/prompt-caching.md (Economics), shared/model-migration.md
units: input and output in USD per million tokens; cacheRead, cacheWrite5m and cacheWrite1h are multipliers of the input price
notes: Standard API rates only. Fast mode, batch, data residency and long-context surcharges are not modeled, and subscription plan usage is not inferred. Model ids match after dropping a trailing [..] tag, a date suffix, and a Bedrock or Vertex prefix or version suffix. An id missing here is an error; an entry with status Unknown is reported as tokens without a price.
